title: The Kronos Mission
headline: Doing the right thing, in the open.
tagline: How Kronos operates and why — high scientific and mathematical standards, honesty about what the technology is and is not, designing in the open, and building to uplift humanity.

high-standards: Physics and mathematical rigor; verification and reproducibility as an ethic.
honesty-transparency: The honest gates, never overclaiming, correcting the record.
designing-in-the-open: Open papers, open data and DOIs, open licenses — we say it and we do it.
environment-and-planet: The clean-planet case and the healed-Earth endgame.
building-for-humanity: Energy access, uplift, and who fusion serves.
impact: An honest look at the effect on people, on AI and compute, and on society.
